question: Can bounded explicit local structural repair preserve familiar causal readouts and predict unfamiliar causal changes with less computation than a correctly modeled, fully fitted Bayesian active planner?

worlds.latent_hypotheses: all 31 nonempty XOR masks x 2 bias bits, 62 total

generative_source: Deterministic seeded pseudorandom binary interventions: OLD parity of unknown mask and bias, then zero, one, or two edge-bit changes; truth never passed to learners; paired conditional outcome streams keyed by seed,scenario,input,observation ordinal. Old observations shared.
hypothesis_engine: Estimate OLD_MAP from 24 OLD samples over 62 hypotheses with uniform old prior and known .10 noise. Preserve OLD readout immutable. NEW hypothesis prior for each hypothesis is exp(-HammingDistance(old_mask,mask)-bias_flip), normalized. Candidate first uses only mask distances <=1, dynamically expands to <=2 if cumulative negative log predictive likelihood per NEW observation exceeds .75 at or after observation 6. Re-score every prior NEW observation after expansion. Full Bayesian controls retain all 62 hypotheses at all times.

arms.local_active: Candidate truncated/expandable Bayes structure hypothesis committee; next context maximizing committee predictive binary entropy over 32 possible interventions.
arms.full_bayes_ig: Strong conventional full 62-hypothesis Bayesian active planner with identical prior/noise and same expected-entropy intervention score.
arms.full_bayes_random: Same full 62-hypothesis posterior with deterministic random intervention contexts.
arms.local_on_bayes_trace: Candidate local repair trained on identical consequences and intervention sequence produced by full_bayes_ig (estimator ablation).

measurement: Per-arm averaged held binary Brier over 32 contexts x 20 held outcomes, per scenario and overall, shift-induced mask identification, false-positive change reports in NULL, old predictive retention after JSON serialize/reparse, exact action/observation counts, unique coverage, deterministic count of hypothesis-likelihood and query-prediction evaluations (cost proxy, not measured CPU).
success: DEV_SIGNAL only if local_active Brier <= full_bayes_ig Brier + .015 overall and in every scenario; >=2.0x fewer counted hypothesis evaluations including OLD fit and all NEW fit/action/evaluation; >=80% correct changed-mask recovery on SINGLE_EDGE+DOUBLE_EDGE; <=5% per-world NULL false changes; 100% exact retained OLD readouts. Otherwise NO_GO. No scientific-pass claim without independent replica and native owner strong controls.
integrity: One prereg commit, then one source commit, exact Git blob readback before smoke and primary; one disjoint smoke world per scenario then one frozen 12x3 primary only; no replay, no threshold tuning, no seed reuse. Preserve negatives.
isolation: Source-free synthetic research contributor; append-only in existing draft PR #1346. No accepted main, native learned-state integration, owner loop, runner, schedules, paid APIs, scientific first-use, merge or deployment.
